source.scope: Proposal-only procedures for EXT-F-4121-T01 through EXT-F-4124-T01. No canonical inventory/status changes and no runtime execution.
source.manual_execution_route: In a signed-in member or admin profile: side panel > Tools > Catalog, choose Internal or All surface if needed, search the exact tool, expand, replace JSON and Run. ToolsView validates local argsSchema, then calls handler.run directly with conversationId=null, runId=manual-test, permissionMode=act, assignedTabId=null and emits local TOOL_TIMELINE_EVENT started/completed/error. This bypasses dispatch.ts permission/approval routing and aidream execution. TOOL_ASK_USER_REQUEST is still broadcast to the inbox; its null conversation falls back to the currently selected chat, where the card can be answered. A manual result is UI handler evidence only; it does not create the server tool call/message lifecycle or prove streamed tool_event/tool message persistence.
source.build_reload_identity: Before any eventual execution, follow docs/stabilization/PLAN.md § Build and reload contract: resource permit and receipt with source/dirty hash, lockfile/output hashes, WXT mode, extension runtime ID, Chrome version, actual profile/auth/role/org, permissions, backend, fixture IDs and timestamp. Verify the loaded unpacked runtime/build. After relevant build/config changes reload extension, reopen side panel and confirm replacement identity. DevTools-open inspection is not evidence of idle worker restart.
source.role_applicability: Run member and admin separately and retain separate observations. The inventory marks guest not applicable because Tools requires sign-in; guest denial belongs to the Tools UI case. Role applicability does not imply an admin-only restriction: current metadata marks these bindings admin_only=false. Do not change the existing guest/member/admin status cells from this proposal.

EXT-F-4121-T01.title: Controlled manual execution: user
preconditions_fixtures: Complete shared build/reload identity and role setup above. Select an existing disposable test conversation in the side panel before opening Tools so null-conversation ask cards can fall back to that selected conversation.

Use only non-sensitive synthetic content. Do not use type=secret, enter secrets, or send a real notification. The handler's prompt/response can expose input in UI receipts. No backend fixture is needed for a simple question.
steps: In the selected test conversation, while the Chat tab is mounted, open the ask-user card inbox and confirm there is no pre-existing card with this case’s synthetic text.

Switch to Tools and run {"type":"choice","question":"Procedure fixture: choose the marked option","options":["fixture-A","fixture-B"],"context":"owned manual tool procedure","timeout_seconds":60}. The handler broadcasts the ask request and waits for a response.

Switch back to Chat. Confirm the card appears in the selected conversation with the exact synthetic question/options. Choose fixture-B and submit; observe the card closes/disappears. Do not return to Tools to inspect a result: switching tabs unmounts ToolsView and its local result state is not a durable result surface.

Repeat with the cancellation-control input {"type":"choice","question":"Procedure fixture: cancellation control","options":["fixture-A","fixture-B"],"timeout_seconds":60}; cancel the visible card and observe it closes. The resulting handler envelope is not observable on a durable surface in this route.
While Tools is mounted, run {"type":"choice","question":"invalid input control","options":[],"timeout_seconds":60}. Observe the local schema/refinement error and confirm no ask card was broadcast.

For reload coverage, finish all pending cards first. Reload the extension, reopen Chat and Tools, then repeat the card-lifecycle positive once. Record only card appearance and closure; do not claim an inline result or worker-idle restart.
expected: The positive card visibly contains the synthetic question/options; selecting fixture-B closes/removes that card. Cancellation also closes/removes its card. These are observable inbox lifecycle outcomes only; the handler response envelope is not observable after switching away from Tools because the awaiting ToolsView is unmounted and its local result state is lost.
The invalid options input displays a local validation error in Tools before handler invocation and produces no card. Notification permission is not exercised by this chosen branch.

Only direct manual handler/card behavior is evidenced. The manual timeline event is not an aidream tool_event or persisted role=tool message. Dispatcher gating, live agent invocation, streaming delivery, message persistence, permission denial and cold worker restart remain unverified.
EXT-F-4121-T01.cleanup: Resolve or cancel every synthetic pending card before leaving the conversation. No persistent backend data is created by this chosen branch.

EXT-F-4122-T01.title: Controlled manual execution: request_user_takeover
preconditions_fixtures: Complete shared build/reload identity and role setup above. Select an existing disposable test conversation so the inbox can associate the null-conversation manual request with the selected chat.

Omit tab_id: this avoids focusing another tab and isolates the takeover request/card behavior. Use synthetic reason/instructions only; do not claim browser control was transferred based on the card alone.
steps: In the selected test conversation, while Chat is mounted, verify no existing ask card contains this case’s synthetic reason.

Switch to Tools and run {"reason":"Owned manual takeover procedure","instructions":"Read the visible fixture page and report its heading in this card","expected_action":"Reply with the word fixture-complete","timeout_seconds":60}. Omit tab_id to avoid tab activation.

Switch back to Chat. Confirm the card displays the reason plus both instructions and expected action. Reply with fixture-complete and observe that the card closes/disappears. Do not return to Tools to inspect the handler result; ToolsView unmounts on tab switch and its local result is lost.
While Tools is mounted, run {"reason":"invalid control","timeout_seconds":0}. Observe local schema validation error and confirm no ask card appears.
Resolve all cards before extension reload. After reloading, reopen Chat and Tools and repeat the positive card lifecycle once; record card appearance/closure only.
expected: The visible card question contains the reason, instructions and expected action; submitting the synthetic text closes the card. This proves a user-facing takeover prompt/card lifecycle only; the resulting answer envelope is not observable through this manual route.
The invalid timeout is rejected by local schema validation. No tab activation occurs because tab_id is omitted.

Direct manual execution does not establish agent pause/resume, tab assignment, server tool_event, persisted tool message, dispatcher permission gate or live binding behavior. Those remain unverified without an actual agent-dispatched fixture.
EXT-F-4122-T01.cleanup: Resolve the ask card by replying before leaving. No browser tab state or backend data is changed by the proposed inputs.

EXT-F-4123-T01.title: Controlled manual execution: update_plan
preconditions_fixtures: Complete shared build/reload identity and role setup above. Select an existing disposable test conversation and open its plan/tasks panel before running.

Use synthetic plan content and omit domains to avoid implying that browser navigation is authorized. Direct Tools execution passes conversationId=null: it can render and answer the approval card but deliberately skips savePlan/setPlanStatus/addTasks persistence. Therefore this procedure is only a manual prompt/result smoke; persistence/approval-to-task acceptance requires a real agent-dispatched conversation fixture and must remain unverified without one. Capture the panel baseline before running; a post-run absence assertion without this before-state is not meaningful.
steps: In Chat, select the disposable test conversation and open its plan/tasks panel. Record the visible baseline: whether a plan exists, its title/status if present, and existing task count/titles (synthetic/non-sensitive only). This is the before-state for the negative persistence observation.

Switch to Tools and run {"title":"Owned plan procedure","steps":["Inspect the owned test conversation","Record the visible result"],"reasoning":"Synthetic manual procedure","estimated_minutes":2,"timeout_seconds":60}.

Switch back to Chat. Confirm the approval card displays title, reasoning, ordered steps and estimate. Select Reject and observe the card closes/disappears. Do not return to Tools to inspect the result; ToolsView local result state is lost on unmount.

Reopen the same conversation’s plan/tasks panel and compare against the captured baseline. Because manual Tools supplies conversationId=null, no plan save/status update/task population is expected; record only whether the panel matches its before-state. This does not prove the agent persistence path.
Switch to Tools and run {"steps":[],"timeout_seconds":60}. Observe local validation error and no card. Since no handler runs, the panel should remain at the captured baseline.

Finish with no pending card. After extension reload, reopen the same conversation and verify the plan panel still matches the captured baseline; this is only an absence check for the manual route, not persistence acceptance.
expected: The card shows the synthetic plan fields; selecting Reject closes it. The response envelope is not visible on a durable surface after switching away from Tools.
The empty steps input is rejected before handler execution. Compare plan/task state with the explicit before-state; do not infer absence of prior data from an empty-looking or unrecorded panel.

No plan persistence or task population is expected on this direct route because conversationId is null. Live agent invocation, proposed/approved/rejected storage, approved-plan task creation, tool_event/tool message persistence, dispatcher gates and cold worker restart remain unverified without a real agent-dispatched fixture.
EXT-F-4123-T01.cleanup: Reject the proposal and clear any ask card. Since conversationId is null, the proposed path should not create local plan or task records.

EXT-F-4124-T01.title: Controlled manual execution: user_todos
not_executable_reasons: The only repository UI procedure identified for this inventory slice is Tools > Catalog > Run. ToolsView invokes handler.run with conversationId=null, and user_todos returns {ok:false,reason:"No active conversation"} before any of its six actions; thus none of the seven inventory controls can be executed through this real UI route.

No usable live-agent fixture is available in this task: there is no provided member/admin test profile plus a real selected Chat/Pilot conversation and an agent/mandate known to issue the registered user_todos call through aidream. The inventory labels agent calls deferred with Chat/Pilot, so the direct manual runner cannot substitute. Do not invent or inject a conversation ID, construct a fake tool event, or claim handler-level tests establish the live route.
future_fixture_requirements: Required before this case can be executable: provide an owned member and admin browser profile and an actual UI-created conversation on a surface with a live agent/mandate that can issue the current registered user_todos binding. Confirm the agent call is routed by aidream and carries that conversation’s real ID. No such fixture or invocation path is supplied here.

If that fixture becomes available, record the selected conversation and baseline todos in TaskPanel; prompt the live agent to add a unique synthetic todo with silent=true; observe the rendered tool call/message and resulting owned todo in TaskPanel. Continue with list, update, mark_done true then false, remove, and clear_done using only case-owned todo IDs. For clear_done, add a second case-owned todo and mark it done; verify unrelated baseline todos remain. Repeat readback after extension reload.

Capture real agent tool-call/result evidence and visible conversation-local TaskPanel state separately. The current component contract can show the tool row and list panel, but no source-only procedure can claim their runtime output without the missing live fixture. Include schema-negative input and unknown owned ID only after a real tool invocation route exists.
